notes: Rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28 (owner: "survival will be a melee hunter spec"). Rewritten from a ranged-shots-plus-Raptor-Strike-weave rotation to a real melee rotation: the character starts in melee range (no prepull move -- StartDistanceFromTarget defaults to 0, well inside core.MaxMeleeAttackDistance) and never leaves it, so Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot, Arcane Shot and Serpent Sting -- every one of them gated on core.MinRangedAttackDistance (12 yd) in this engine -- are removed rather than declared inert or expected_idle: they are not lines this rotation names any more, and a spec that commits fully to melee for the whole fight cannot ever satisfy both that gate and Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite/Counterattack/Strider Kick's core.MaxMeleeAttackDistance (5 yd) gate at once under this engine's single static per-fight distance. Wing Clip is also deliberately left out: it is a control tool (a snare/immobilize), not a damage line worth a GCD against a stationary target, matching how a real Survival player would not snare a training dummy either -- the ladder's own 'learned but unused' list will keep naming it at every level it is learned, which is the expected, reviewed state for a line this file chooses not to carry. The engine side of this rewrite is sim/hunter's melee kit: Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite's damage corrected to this build's own client numbers (both previously carried vanilla Classic's higher numbers), Mongoose Bite's old dodge-gate removed (the Forever client's own tooltip, wowhead.com/forever/spell=1495, lists no such requirement), and three previously-unimplemented Survival talent abilities added: Counterattack (parry-triggered, cannot be dodged/parried/blocked), Strider Kick (100% weapon damage, 8s cooldown) and Lacerating Strikes (a bleed on Mongoose Bite). Raptor Strike is still queued at tag 3 (pipeline/apl.py's ON_NEXT_SWING_QUEUE_TAG, the odd one out among the on-next-swing abilities) as the swing-timer weave, gated at 20% mana so it does not starve Mongoose Bite. Counterattack and Mongoose Bite are bare casts -- Counterattack's own ExtraCastCondition only lets it land while its parry-triggered proc aura is up (the same 'free line that falls through otherwise' shape this site's warrior-arms.json already uses for Overpower), and Mongoose Bite's own mana cost and 5s cooldown are gate enough now that the dodge requirement is gone. Strider Kick is the lowest-priority filler on its own 8s cooldown. 2026-09-28 (night-traps): added Immolation Trap (top rank, spell 14305) below Mongoose Bite as an on-cooldown filler now that sim/hunter/immolation_trap.go's ActionIDs are repointed from client-absent placeholder ids to the real ones (13795/14302-14305) and its shared "Traps" category cooldown corrected to the client's 30s -- it lands within Survival's existing 5-yard melee range gate and adds a small ranged-flavored fire DoT on top of the melee weave without contesting Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite's own priority. There is no spammable melee filler between these cooldowns and Raptor Strike's swing-timer weave -- Classic-era hunters never had one -- so a GCD with nothing else ready is spent on nothing beyond the auto-attack itself, same as live Classic Survival play. Rotation search (2026-10-07, after the engine began charging Strider Kick its client price of 5.81% base mana): Raptor Strike's 20% mana gate is dropped and Strider Kick moves above Immolation Trap; about +3% in that run. 2026-10-07 (mongoose): Mongoose Bite is gated on its client window again (spell 5302, opened by a dodge or by Expose Prey), see design/reviews/2026-10-07-mongoose-bite.md. Rotation search (2026-10-07, Mongoose Bite gated on its window): Lacerate inserted above Strider Kick, measured beyond error. Lacerate line (2026-10-07): adopted from the rotation search beyond error once Mongoose Bite was gated to its window; see design/reviews/2026-10-07-mongoose-bite.md.

expected_idle.reason: Counterattack only lands while its parry-triggered proc aura is active (hunter.CounterattackProcAura), which only activates off an OnSpellHitTaken parry -- i.e. it requires the TARGET to attack the hunter. This ladder's (and the site's own production sim's) target dummy carries TankIndex: -1 and no SwingSpeed/MinBaseDamage (sim/request/request.go's targetStats/encounter), so it never auto-attacks anyone; nothing in a bare, untanked single-character run can ever trigger a parry, at any level, in any of the 300 iterations. This is a property of the shared encounter builder every spec's ladder run shares, not a defect in this rotation or in sim/hunter/counterattack.go -- Counterattack is correctly wired and dealt real damage in sim/hunter/survival_melee_test.go's own TestCounterattackLevel60ProcsOnParryAndDealsClientDamage, which activates the proc aura directly rather than waiting on an attack that this harness's target never makes.

Mongoose Bite only lands inside its window (hunter.MongooseBiteWindowAura, spell 5302), which a dodge or an Expose Prey proc opens. The ladder target never attacks, so no dodge comes, and Expose Prey is a tier-4 Survival talent the guide build cannot reach at levels 20 and 30, so the line is idle until the build spends it. From the level it does, the ladder's marked target (the survival kit carries Hunter's Mark) lets the talent open the window.

Wing Clip is gated on the Windfury Totem buff (spell 10610), which the engine registers only for a character a totem reaches; the ladder character has no raid around it, so the gate is false and the line correctly never fires at any level. In the raid-ready run it is the spec's free-global filler.

priorityList.notes: Raptor Strike queued on the swing timer (tag 3, the on-next-swing queue tag), gated at 20% mana so it does not starve Mongoose Bite below.
Counterattack: a bare cast that only lands while its parry-triggered proc aura is active.

Mongoose Bite inside its window: the client allows it only after a dodge, and Expose Prey opens the same 5 second window (Defensive State, spell 5302) on a melee or ranged attack against a Hunter's Mark target; the window is one charge, spent by the cast. A target that never attacks gives no dodge, so without Expose Prey the line stays idle.
Lacerate (the trainable bleed, rank 4) whenever its own bleed is down: with Mongoose Bite waiting on its window, the free globals go to keeping the bleed ticking.
Strider Kick as the lowest-priority filler on its own 8s cooldown.
Immolation Trap on cooldown: within 5 yards it lands as a melee-range filler, gated only by its own 30-second cooldown and mana cost.

Wing Clip on every free global, only while a Windfury Totem reaches the hunter (the gate asks whether the engine registered the totem's attack power buff, spell 10610, so a character with no totem skips the line): a cheap main-hand special that rolls the totem's extra attack and any weapon proc, which the other lines leave idle. It costs 80 mana and does 50 damage; the client states both. Without the totem it measured as a loss, mana and a global spent for 50 damage.

engineering_notes.2: The same shape warrior-arms.json's own Overpower line uses (that file's step 5): a proc-gated bare cast with no combo-point or resource condition.
